Gantry keyboard jog

Connect both boards and enable jogging. Hold an arrow key or an on-screen arrow to accelerate to the maximum speed. Release to slow down over a few half steps. One direction at a time; let the axis stop before changing direction.

Release can add up to 8 half steps of deceleration, plus USB/input latency.

No homing or travel limits. Stay clear of the ends. Direction depends on wiring; physical distance is uncalibrated. Focus loss, connection loss and faults stop immediately. Coils release when stopped. Half stepping alternates one and two energized coils and can generate more heat.

Connect two different boards with updated braking firmware. Jogging starts disabled.
